# Full-screen app active (`fullscreen`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal automations

True when a full-screen app, game or presentation is in the foreground.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | true / false | no | `true` | Set to false to require that no full-screen app is active. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: fullscreen
    active: true
```
